documents.applicationRoute: In-person and mail applications use printed photos; online renewals use a digital photo. A commercial photographer must take the photo.
documents.photoAgeRule: Taken no more than six months before the application is submitted.
documents.glassesPolicy: Glasses are permitted if the eyes are visible and lenses have no glare; tinted glasses are not accepted.
documents.headCoveringPolicy: Daily religious or medical head coverings are permitted with the full face visible and no facial shadows.
documents.expressionPolicy: Look at the camera with eyes open, mouth closed, and no smile or frown.
documents.childrenNotes: Newborns may show a range of facial expressions; hands must not appear in the photo.
documents.digitalUploadNotes: Online renewal photos must be JPEG, 1200–3000 pixels wide by 1800–4500 pixels high, and 200 KB–5 MB. Scans and altered images are not accepted.
authorityRejectionReasons: White clothing that blends into the background.

faq.question: Can I really just take a casual selfie against any messy wall?
faq.answer: Yes, 100%! You don't need a white backdrop, studio lights, or fancy camera equipment. Take a selfie on your phone or webcam from your couch. Our AI automatically detects you, eliminates all background clutter, levels out shadows, and swaps in the exact solid consular backdrop required by your destination country.

faq.question: What if my selfie is tilted, uncentered, or not aligned?
faq.answer: Don't worry at all. Our 22-point biometric engine automatically detects your eye baseline, auto-straightens slight head tilt, centers your facial oval, and scales your head height to the exact official millimeter ratio (e.g. 50–69% for US, 70–80% for UK/EU).
